outputs.explanation: Scatter plot where each of the 141 points is an individual sample measurement; marginal histograms show distribution. Scatter plots are exempt from requiring additional point overlay.
Scatter plot (mean ± s.d. per cell line/reporter across replicates); scatter-type plots are exempt from the individual-points requirement.
Line/density plots showing subtype-averaged period and amplitude distributions; line plots are exempt as overlaying points would make them unreadable.
Box plot of ridge lengths; box plots are inherently exempt, and individual sample data points are additionally overlaid as dots on each box.
Polar histograms depicting the distribution/frequency of Bmal1-Per2 phase differences over time per cell line; histogram-style distribution plots do not require point overlay.
Polar histogram of subtype-averaged phase differences; a distribution/frequency plot, not a mean-bar chart requiring individual point overlay.
Illustrative example fit on a single representative trace, not an averaged summary statistic requiring individual data points.
Scatter plot where each of the 117 samples is plotted individually with error bars from fitting; scatter plots are exempt from the overlay requirement.
